support.en:
Check the actual usable backing rectangle against your confirmed studio policy before loading. Correct any HOLD, remeasure, and complete all four human checks for the current revision.

Use Settings → Full Backup to save a complete .loadquiltbackup package outside this device. CSV is a summary, not a complete backup. Restore validates the package, saves a safety backup and replaces the entire business library; it does not import purchases.

If save or restore fails, keep the error and your existing library. Do not delete the app or database to repair it. LoadQuilt does not control machinery, certify safety or guarantee quilting quality.

support.zh-CN:
LoadQuilt帮助长臂绗缝师记录实收面层和背布、四边余量、方向与问题，并复核当前版本和签发检查单。不是机器控制或安全认证，无需账号。

工作流程

先使用离线示例，设置工作室余量，再创建工作记录和实收尺寸。HOLD时解决问题和重测，人工确认当前版本后才能READY、签发票据和记录上机。相关修改使旧确认失效，保留历史票据。

购买

独立零美元非消耗型7-day Trial从首次已验证原始交易开始604800秒；无自动扣费、订阅或自动转订阅。Lifetime Unlock美国参考价19.99美元，一次性购买，以Apple实际显示价格为准。设置中用同一Apple账号恢复购买。到期后已有资料仍可读取、导出、备份、恢复与删除。

备份

CSV不是完整备份。导出.loadquiltbackup文档包保存业务记录、照片、历史PDF和事件，不含购买权益。保存到设备外私有位置。恢复先验证和显示数量，经确认替换整库，不合并；失败保留旧库。设备内副本不保护卸载或丢机，手工iCloud Drive文件不是自动同步。

求助提供版本、设备、步骤和错误简述，不发送密码或不必要客户资料。

privacy.en:
LoadQuilt stores customer display names, jobs, measurements, photos, issues and tickets locally on your device. It has no account, backend, ads, tracking, analytics SDK or CloudKit synchronization.

Apple handles trial activation, purchase and restore. These operations may require internet access. Photos are selected through the system picker; camera permission is requested only when you choose to take a photo. Saved photos are re-encoded without GPS metadata.

You choose whether and where to share PDF, CSV and backup packages. These files can contain customer names and photos. Manual saving to iCloud Drive is not automatic app synchronization. Device-local backups do not protect against uninstall, hardware failure or device loss.

You can view, export, back up, restore and delete existing records after trial expiry or purchase revocation. Changes to privacy information will reflect actual shipped functionality.

privacy.zh-CN:
生效日期：2026年10月8日，LoadQuilt 1.0。

客户名、工作、尺寸、照片、问题和检查单保存在设备本地。无账号、服务器、广告、追踪、分析SDK或CloudKit同步；Hailink Labs不收集本地业务资料。

Apple处理试用、购买和恢复，可能需要联网。照片通过系统选择器选取，拍照时才请求相机权限。保存照片重新编码并移除GPS。

你主动选择PDF、CSV和备份的保存或分享位置；文件可能含客户姓名和照片。完整备份是可读取文档包，不受密码加密，哈希只用于完整性校验。手动保存至iCloud Drive不是自动同步。

本地备份不能保护卸载、丢机或硬件故障，请保存设备外副本。恢复经验证及确认替换整库，不合并；外部副本需另行删除。试用到期或权益撤销后，已有资料仍可查看、导出、备份、恢复和删除。

支持邮件与本地资料分开，请勿发送密码或不必要客户资料。
